scenario.shared_setting: Four adults have shared a rented HDB flat for eight months. There is one kitchen with one stove, and all four people cook there. The household has never agreed any rules about the kitchen. After eight months, you all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Rachel Pereira is Catholic, Wei Ming is Buddhist, Nurul is Muslim and eats halal, and Karthik is Hindu and does not eat beef. It is a weeknight evening and all four are in the kitchen and the living area next to it. All four will be living here and using this kitchen again tomorrow, and for the rest of the lease.
